def titleize_sentence(sentence)
  # Define words that should remain lowercase
  lowercase_words = %w[and the or in with of]

  # Split the sentence into words
  words = sentence.split

  # Titleize each word, but keep lowercase words in lowercase
  titleized_words = words.map do |word|
    if lowercase_words.include?(word.downcase)
      word.downcase
    else
      word.capitalize
    end
  end

  # Join the words back into a sentence
  titleized_words.join(' ')
end
